parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more specific, quantified actions (exact dollar amounts, concrete ticker choices like NOBL/SCHD for income) and better addresses the user's explicit income-generation question with dedicated dividend-focused recommendations. System B has stronger diversification framing (addressing both sector concentration and geographic diversification) but is slightly less actionable and its Rec #1 suggestion to increase Healthcare from 22% to 24-25% contradicts its own Rec #4 which trims Healthcare, creating an internal inconsistency.
